We must therefore rely on inbound attraction mechanics and warm-network B2B transfers to maintain momentum.

reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the opposing agents—potential contractor clients and card dealers—as rational utility maximizers facing their own liquidity constraints. They will only convert if the perceived reduction in their operational friction (missed calls, manual valuation) outweighs the switching cost and trust deficit of adopting a new AI tool. The Founder must act as a signal amplifier, using their HR leadership background to project stability and competence, effectively lowering the client's perceived risk premium.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A strict anti-collinearity veto is applied to prevent resource leakage. If the Founder begins coding instead of selling, or if Laguna starts designing complex UIs instead of bare-metal APIs, the system violates the orthogonality principle. We also veto any strategy relying on 'parking' Down South; it is the primary grounding wire for the entire electrical grid of this venture. Any deviation toward generic job searching is immediately suppressed as it introduces destructive interference with the entrepreneurial momentum.
